backstory.name: salt_flat_surveyor
backstory.title: Salt-flat surveyor
backstory.desc: {name} walked the white flats with a chain and a sighting pole, marking where the crust would bear a wagon. {They} learned to read distance in shimmering air and to trust numbers over eyes.

backstory.name: mule_train_drover
backstory.title: Mule-train drover
backstory.desc: For years {name} led strings of pack mules over mountain passes, sleeping beside the loads. {They} could calm a balking animal with a word and settle an argument with a stick.

backstory.name: well_diggers_child
backstory.title: Well-digger's child
backstory.desc: {name} spent {their} childhood at the bottom of other people's wells, passing up buckets of clay and listening for water. Dark, narrow places never frightened {them} again.
